CPI week.
What moves gold?
slides.visual: Cover: dark navy field, REX looking at a calendar; clean upper third for headline.

slides.headline: Gold bounced on Friday.
slides.body: US yields eased from a 24-year high and the dollar softened. One bounce is not a trend.

slides.headline: US CPI
slides.visual: Large clock/calendar motif; time set in Inter.

slides.headline: Inflation → Fed expectations → yields & USD → gold
slides.body: Gold reacts to yields and the dollar, not to CPI directly.

slides.headline: Above, in line, below expectations
slides.body: Each can move yields and USD. We explain how after release; we do not predict.
